name: Ministry of Darkness
caption: A CHWE stable billing the real WWF Ministry of Darkness name over three of the fed's own wrestlers.
notes: Each of the three wrestlers' own roster entries names "Ministry of Darkness" as their stable; the fed borrows the real WWF stable's own name and pairs two of its real-wrestler billings (Undertaker, Viscera) with one original character (Phantom).

name: DX
caption: A CHWE stable billing the real WWF DX name over two of the fed's own real-wrestler billings.
notes: Both Rob Van Dam's and The Rock's own roster entries name "DX" as their stable — the fed borrows the real WWF faction's own name over two real-wrestler billings that were never actually DX members on television.
